Firmware

Firmware architecture
The firmware runs on the ESP32-C3. It uses ESP-IDF 5.5.3 and FreeRTOS. The code is in Firmware/. The application is in main/, and the board support is in components/bsp/.

Sources: Firmware/flows/coach.flow.json (states and transitions), wc -l (lines, BSP included), and Firmware/tests/.
Layers


Figure 9. Firmware layers. The modules with a green frame are plain C. They do not use LVGL or ESP-IDF, and they run in host tests.


The design has two rules:

Keep the logic away from the hardware. The state machine, key mapping, protocol codec, session rules, and ADPCM are plain C. You can test them on a computer.
Compile the canvas into C at build time. The state machine is a graph in coach.flow.json. flowc.py translates it into a C transition table. The device has no graph interpreter, so the runtime cost is zero (tools/flow/flowc.py, file header).

Startup order
Source: main/main.c

01Read the wake causeAfter a key wake, the device ignores keys until the user releases that key (maximum 10 s). Thus, the wake key does not operate the device.
02I2C, screen, and LVGLIf initialization fails, the device logs the SPI pins and stops. The backlight goes to 100%.
03Audio and fuel gaugeES8311 and CW2017. A failure does not stop the startup. The device records the status.
04Start the Coach appMake the queues. Start the voice task, the BLE link, and the coach task.
05Enable the keys lastKey events go into the queue only after the app is ready.


Tasks and queues


Figure 10. Task priorities, stack sizes, and queues. Sources: main/audio/voice.c:20-23, main/link/ble_link.c:27-32, main/coach_app.c:50-52, esp_lvgl_port defaults, and sdkconfig.


The reasons for the priorities:

voice is the highest (7). Audio has one block each 20 ms. A late block causes a gap in the sound (voice.c:23, comment).
ble_tx is next (6). It sends control packets first and audio packets second.
coach is 5. Keys, timers, and link events go into one queue. Thus, the state machine handles one event at a time, without concurrency problems.
LVGL is 4. Drawing can wait for audio and BLE.

Each queue has a fixed size and a fixed overflow rule. A slow link does not make a queue larger (需求文件夹/02-architecture.md, section 5).
State machine
The state machine has 10 states and 83 transitions. flowc.py makes all of them from coach.flow.json into main/generated/coach_flow.c.



Group
States
Description




Pages
LIVE, REPORT, TURNS
Live data, report, and Turns. A short press of UP or DOWN moves in the loop.


Coach
READY, CAPTURE, WAIT_ANSWER, PLAYBACK
Ready, recording, waiting for the answer, and playback.


Popup
POPUP_WAIT, POPUP_PLAY, POPUP_HOLD
Waiting for voice, playing voice, and the 10 s countdown.



Two timers (docs/heygo-changes.md, section 6):

After 20 s in CAPTURE, the timer sends CAPTURE_LIMIT. A recording is 20 s at most.
After 10 s in WAIT_ANSWER, the timer sends AGENT_TIMEOUT.

Only one screen exists at a time. To change the screen, the task loads an empty screen, deletes the old screen, and then builds the new screen. Several screens at the same time do not fit in the LVGL pool.
The page rail is an exception. It is one object on the LVGL top layer that draws the four stops and the thumb. A screen change does not delete it. Thus, the rail uses only one object of the pool on each page (main/ui/page_rail.h, coach_app.c:749).
Audio path

Up · recordingMicrophone to phoneES8311 samples at 16 kHz, 16 bit. The voice task encodes one 164-byte ADPCM block each 20 ms. The block goes to the audio TX queue (8 packets, drop the oldest). ble_tx then sends it as a NimBLE notification.
Down · playbackPhone to speakerNimBLE receives the packet. link_core checks the xid and accepts only the current stream. The block goes to the down queue (8 blocks). play_gate decides when playback starts. The device decodes the block and sends it through I2S and ES8311 to the speaker.


A 20 s question in raw PCM needs 640,000 bytes. The device has no PSRAM. Thus, it sends the recording while it records, and it does not keep the full recording (02-architecture.md, section 5).

启动顺序
来源：main/main.c

01查看唤醒原因如果是按键唤醒，先屏蔽按键，等那颗键松手（最多 10 秒），避免唤醒键被当成一次操作。

任务和队列


图 10　任务优先级、栈大小和队列。来源：main/audio/voice.c:20-23、main/link/ble_link.c:27-32、main/coach_app.c:50-52、esp_lvgl_port 默认配置、sdkconfig。


优先级这样排的原因：

voice 最高（7）。 音频每 20 ms 一块，晚了就会断音（voice.c:23 注释）。
ble_tx 其次（6）。 先发控制包，再发音频包。
coach 是 5。 按键、计时器、链路事件都进同一个队列，所以状态机一次只处理一个事件，没有并发问题。
LVGL 是 4。 画屏可以让路给音频和蓝牙。

每个队列大小固定，溢出规则写死。链路慢的时候不扩大队列（需求文件夹/02-architecture.zh_CN.md 第 5 节）。

说明

POPUP_WAIT、POPUP_PLAY、POPUP_HOLD
等语音、播语音、10 秒倒计时



两个计时器（docs/heygo-changes.zh_CN.md 第 6 节）：

CAPTURE 状态 20 秒后产生 CAPTURE_LIMIT，录音最长 20 秒。
WAIT_ANSWER 状态 10 秒后产生 AGENT_TIMEOUT。

同一时间只存在一个界面。切换时先载入空白界面，删掉旧界面，再建新界面，因为几个界面同时存在会超出 LVGL 内存池。
页面导轨是例外：它是 LVGL 顶层上的一个对象，自己画出四个格子和滑块，换界面时不删除。所以导轨在每个页面上只占内存池里的一个对象（main/ui/page_rail.h、coach_app.c:749）。
音频通路

上行 · 录音麦克风 → 手机ES8311 以 16 kHz、16 bit 采样 → voice 任务每 20 ms 编码成一块 164 字节的 ADPCM → 音频发送队列（8 包，满了丢最旧的）→ ble_tx → NimBLE 通知。
下行 · 播放手机 → 喇叭NimBLE 收包 → link_core 检查 xid，只收当前流 → 下行队列（8 块）→ play_gate 判断何时起播 → 解码 → I2S → ES8311 → 喇叭。


一个 20 秒的问题如果存成裸 PCM，需要 640,000 字节。设备没有 PSRAM，所以录音边录边发，不存整段（02-architecture.zh_CN.md 第 5 节）。
